description: Agent Consent: submit the principal’s grant and the planned use: the grant with its id, who gave it, who it was given to, the data it covers by category, the actions it allows, the recipients who may receive the data or the result, the data, actions and recipients it rules out by name and its wording, read for catch-all wording such as any data, and other information or our partners; and the use with who will run it, the data it touches, the action it takes, the recipients of the data or the result and its description. The signed report gives the grant with any catch-all wording, every item the use relies on with its dimension (data, action or recipient) and its status as covered, excluded, catch_all, outside or unread, and counts the items covered, outside, excluded, reached by catch-all wording and unread, and names a use out of scope: data, an action or a recipient outside the lists the grant states, anything the grant rules out by name and a use run by another party than the one the grant was given to; then items reached only through catch-all wording and a grant that names no grantee, with the fix for each. Items compare word for word, a plural read as its singular; a list the grant does not state leaves the items in it unread. This reads one planned use against the grant, item by item: one proposed sharing of live context against the owner’s sharing rules is wever_context-sharing-check, a delegation’s written bounds are wever_delegation-scope-check, what a memory system keeps at all is wever_memory-scope-check and a wallet-scoped permission record evaluated for an exact subject, action and resource is wever_agent-permission-ledger. Verdict consent_out_of_scope, consent_scope_partial, consent_scope_unclear or consent_in_scope. POST /api/consent-scope-check. Reads only the recorded consent material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write; no principal is contacted, no consent is requested, recorded, renewed or withdrawn and no data is used, moved or deleted. Agent Consent reads the grant the principal gave before the agent uses data or acts on it: whether the grant covers this use, whether it is still in force, whether it was withdrawn, whether the record proves it, what it was given for, whether the data may pass on and whether fresh consent is due. It is not the agent’s authority to act (wever_authority-scope-check reads an agent’s access list against the authority grant its operator gave it; a consent check reads the grant the principal gave over their own data: authority is not consent, and consent is not authority), not a mandate (the wever_mandate tools, wever_mandate-issue, wever_mandate-amend, wever_mandate-revoke and wever_mandate-draft, issue and change what an agent may trade or spend for a principal; a consent check reads what the principal agreed may be done with their data and changes nothing), not a data sample (wever_data-evidence-check reads a dataset sample’s fields and types; a consent check reads the permission behind using the data, not the data itself), not terms against a purchase (wever_terms-match-check reads purchases already made against their governing terms; a consent grant is the principal’s permission, not a seller’s terms), not a promise (the wever_commitment checks read what the agent promised; consent is what the principal granted, and an agent’s promise never stands in for it) and not an objective (the wever_goal checks read the objective the work serves; a consent check reads whether the principal’s grant allows the work at all). Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-consent-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-consent/.

actions.description: What the grant allows done with the data, such as read, store or send.

data.description: The data the grant covers, by category, such as contact details or visit history.

excluded.description: Data, actions or recipients the grant rules out by name.

grantee.description: Who it was given to: the agent or service acting on it.

recipients.description: Who may receive the data or the result.

text.description: The grant as worded, read for catch-all wording such as any data, and other information or our partners.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

action.description: What the planned use does with it.

data.description: The data the planned use touches.

recipients.description: Who receives the data or the result.

title: Consent scope check
